Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the demo scheduling. I accepted the invite but several of our engineers say they can't see the calendar entry on their side — it shows up for me but the link resolves to a 403 for others. I'm attaching a screenshot from our SSO flow.

Can we 1) confirm the meeting link will let other attendees join, and 2) if we need to reschedule, propose a backup (dial-in) so folks can still join? We're available Wednesday 12/08 between 10–12 PT or Thursday 12/09 after 2pm PT.

Jordan

Greenline Systems

Jordan —

Appreciate the screenshot. Quick notes:
- From our side the gcal invite was generated as a Google Meet URL but we usually fall back to Zoom when SSO-derived ACLs cause issues.
- Two immediate options:
  1) I can reissue a shortlink Zoom join + temporary dial-in (DTMF) and send as calendar update — that avoids SSO ACLs for guests.
  2) If your IT wants to troubleshoot, we can loop in an ops contact to whitelist redwood.com for the event token. That can take a little longer.

If you want the fast path, I propose we move the meeting to Thu 12/09 2:30pm PT and I'll provision a Zoom shortlink + 1-800 dial-in that we control. Ben will be the temporary host so your team can join immediately even if the Meet organizer metadata is blocked.

Next steps (if OK):
- I’ll send an updated calendar invite with the Zoom shortlink and dial-in.
- Ben (cc'd) will accept host claim at start of meeting and we’ll record for the team.
- If any Greenline attendees still can't join by link, use the dial-in and we’ll bring them into the call.

Let me know if Thursday 2:30pm PT works. If you prefer Wed morning, we can do that too.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Rachel — thanks, Thu 12/09 2:30pm PT works for us.

A couple of asks from our side:
- Can you include the dial-in and shortlink in the calendar description (not just the body of the Meet metadata)? Our users often open the calendar without the full payload and we want the dial-in to be visible.
- Our IT admin asked to be included in any host-swap steps so they can watch the SSO logs if needed: it-admin@greenline.com.

If you could also drop a PDF checklist of the host-claim steps we'll follow (just one page) that would help our ops folks.

Jordan
